title: VALUABLE TEAMS
subtitle: SPORTS - 2010 to 2026
intro: which team is worth the most?
outro: The Cowboys never lost the lead.

Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In twenty ten, soccer giants like Manchester United and Real Madrid topped the world of sports wealth. But American football had other plans. The Dallas Cowboys, without winning a title in decades, became the most valuable team on the planet. NBA franchises surged. By twenty twenty-six, sports teams are worth more than entire companies. Which one leads next? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
